question: Pullela Gopichand won the All England Open Tournament in the year ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 2001.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pullela Gopichand was a surprise **winner of the 2001 All-England Championships.**__
 
• Pullela Gopichand (born 16 November 1973) is a former Indian **badminton player. **Currently, he is the __**Chief National Coach for the India national badminton team.**__
 
• He won the All England Open Badminton **Championships in 2001**, becoming the second Indian to achieve this feat__** after Prakash Padukone.**__
 
• He runs the **Gopichand Badminton Academy.**
 
• He received the** Arjuna Award in 1999, the Dronacharya Award in 2009**, and the Padma Bhushan – India's third-highest civilian award – **in 2014.**
 
• **After retiring from his playing career,** Pullela founded the Gopichand Badminton Academy in 2008 after reportedly mortgaging his own house.
 
• The academy produced several badminton players including **Saina Nehwal, P. V. Sindhu, Sai Praneeth, Parupalli Kashyap**, Srikanth Kidambi, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** **Pullela Gopichand others Awards and honors**

 
• Pullela is awarded the** Padma Shri by President A. P. J. Abdul Kalam, c. 2005**.
 
• Arjuna Award**, 1999.**
 
• Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna, **2001**
 
• Padma Shri,** 2005**
 
• Dronacharya Award, **2009**
 
• Padma Bhushan,** 2014**
 
• Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar, 2013, under Category Establishment and Management of Sports Academies of Excellence- Pullela Gopichand Academy of Badminton, Hyderabad
 
• He was bestowed an honorary doctorate by** IIT Kanpur on the occasion of their 52nd Convocation.**
